description: WirelessXPL-Forge: offline 802.11 / WPA / WPA3 / TKIP / WPE analysis, BLE tooling, and wordlist helpers. Live capture and cracking delegate to system tools (aircrack-ng, hcxtools, hashcat).

operational_policy.note: WirelessXPL-Forge: 802.11/BLE lab orchestration only. Router / switch modules: RouterXPL-Forge; perimeter: FirewallXPL-Forge.
